description: Embeds one immutable audio player with one to four ordered PreservationArchive fallback objects.

parameters.name: label
parameters.label: Accessible label
parameters.description: Short, meaningful description exposed to readers and assistive technology.

parameters.name: transcript
parameters.label: Transcript
parameters.description: Optional plain-text transcript, up to 8192 characters.

parameters.name: source1_sha256
parameters.label: Source 1 SHA-256
parameters.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 of the first archived audio object.

parameters.name: source1_type
parameters.label: Source 1 type
parameters.description: Media format of source1_sha256: ogg or mp3.

parameters.name: source1_filename
parameters.label: Source 1 filename
parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for the first archived object; verified before its provenance link is rendered.

parameters.name: source2_sha256
parameters.label: Source 2 SHA-256
parameters.description: Optional exact lowercase SHA-256 of the second ordered fallback object.

parameters.name: source2_type
parameters.label: Source 2 type
parameters.description: Media format of source2_sha256: ogg or mp3; omit when source2_sha256 is omitted.

parameters.name: source2_filename
parameters.label: Source 2 filename
parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for the second archived object; omit with the rest of source slot 2.

parameters.name: source3_sha256
parameters.label: Source 3 SHA-256
parameters.description: Optional exact lowercase SHA-256 of the third ordered fallback object; source 2 must be present.

parameters.name: source3_type
parameters.label: Source 3 type
parameters.description: Media format of source3_sha256: ogg or mp3; omit when source3_sha256 is omitted.

parameters.name: source3_filename
parameters.label: Source 3 filename
parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for the third archived object; omit with the rest of source slot 3.

parameters.name: source4_sha256
parameters.label: Source 4 SHA-256
parameters.description: Optional exact lowercase SHA-256 of the fourth ordered fallback object; sources 2 and 3 must be present.

parameters.name: source4_type
parameters.label: Source 4 type
parameters.description: Media format of source4_sha256: ogg or mp3; omit when source4_sha256 is omitted.

parameters.name: source4_filename
parameters.label: Source 4 filename
parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for the fourth archived object; omit with the rest of source slot 4.

documentation_wikitext:
{{SHORTDESC:Embed content-addressed audio from PreservationArchive}}
Use this source-neutral template for one to four ordered audio fallback objects already published by PreservationArchive. Source slots must be contiguous and each digest must be paired with its media type and exact source-record filename.

examples.invocation:
{{Preservation audio
| site = example-site
| label = Spoken dialogue sample
| transcript = Optional plain-text transcript.
| source1_sha256 = 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
| source1_type = ogg
| source1_filename = Dialogue sample.ogg
| source2_sha256 = fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210
| source2_type = mp3
| source2_filename = Dialogue sample.mp3
}}
examples.description: An OGG source followed by an MP3 fallback and a plain-text transcript.
